_comment: The five WHINK Group subsidiaries. Facts from the Group website (https://whink-group.onrender.com), read 2026-10-25. Do not add facts beyond these.

subsidiaries.name: Whink Consult
subsidiaries.intro: IT services, implementation, and practical support for business change.
subsidiaries.about: Whink Consult helps organizations turn technology decisions into working solutions. Our focus spans IT services, implementation planning, delivery coordination, and helping teams adopt new ways of working.

services.title: IT services
services.description: Practical support for business technology, systems, and operations.

services.title: Implementation
services.description: Planning, configuration coordination, rollout, and adoption support.

services.title: Project delivery
services.description: Clear milestones, stakeholder coordination, and structured handovers.

subsidiaries.name: Whink Real Estate
subsidiaries.intro: Property flipping, development work, and commercial rentals.
subsidiaries.about: Whink Real Estate focuses on the potential of places: improving properties, progressing development opportunities, and providing commercial rental space.

services.title: Property flipping
services.description: Acquiring and improving properties for resale.

services.title: Development work
services.description: Turning property opportunities into purposeful development projects.

services.title: Commercial rentals
services.description: Spaces for businesses to establish and grow.

subsidiaries.name: Whink Trades & Investments
subsidiaries.intro: The trading arm of Whink Group.
subsidiaries.about: Whink Trades is the trading arm of Whink Group. The company is no longer accepting investors. A trading bot is planned, with further details to be announced.

services.title: Trading operations
services.description: The trading arm of the Whink Group portfolio.

services.title: Trading bot
services.description: Coming soon. Launch timing and capabilities will be announced.

subsidiaries.notice: We are no longer accepting investors. Whink Trades is closed to new investment.

subsidiaries.name: Whink Apps
subsidiaries.intro: Application development, AI, robotics, and technology that advances the way the world works.
subsidiaries.about: Whink Apps is a subsidiary of The WHINK Group. It builds innovative apps, including Whink Ultimate.

subsidiaries.name: Whink Frontliners
subsidiaries.intro: Construction and procurement. A Whink Group subsidiary in Nigeria.
subsidiaries.about: Whink Frontliners is our Nigeria-based construction and procurement firm. It brings construction delivery and sourcing requirements together to support projects from planning through execution.

services.title: Construction
services.description: Construction delivery and project coordination in Nigeria.

services.title: Procurement
services.description: Sourcing and procurement support for project requirements.

services.title: Delivery coordination
services.description: Coordinating materials, suppliers, and project needs.

directors.name: Dr Tinaye Lydia Muzenyi
directors.title: Executive Director & Head of People Operations, Whink Frontliners
